messages:
Maria Chen: FYI I opened a docs PR to add a few practical examples for private installs: SSH bastion, HTTP proxy for air-gapped installs, and a short KMS/HSM config snippet. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
Jorge Patel: nice, will review. can you add a note about the bastion using an ephemeral key vs long-lived key? ops teams prefer ephemeral for reduced blast radius.
Maria Chen: good call — added a paragraph recommending signed ephemeral certs and included an SSH example.
Anika Rao: Also add a security callout about not exposing the KMS admin port to the internet. customers sometimes copy-paste the example and forget firewall rules.
Maria Chen: added firewall wording and a short checklist. can you sanity-check the HSM PKCS#11 example?
Kyle B: quick glance — the pkcs11 lib path in the snippet is linux-specific. maybe show macos and rpm/deb paths?
Maria Chen: updated to include /usr/lib and /usr/local/lib variants.
Nina S: small UX suggestion: include a Python SDK snippet that shows how to point at a private endpoint + client cert (some customers miss the client cert flow). I can paste one.
Maria Chen: please! a tiny snippet is perfect.
Nina S: pasted below — feel free to trim.
Nina S: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(endpoint="https://api.private.redwood.local:7443",
                      cert=("/etc/redwood/certs/client.crt", "/etc/redwood/certs/client.key"),
                      verify="/etc/redwood/certs/ca.pem")
print(client.generate("Say hi"))
```
Jorge Patel: For air-gapped installs add note about an offline Docker registry and image digests so upgrades are deterministic. Example unit for mirroring images?
Maria Chen: added a short systemd + skopeo example. snippet: 
```bash
# mirror images to local registry
skopeo copy --insecure-policy docker://docker.io/redwood/model:sha256-abc registry.local/redwood/model:sha256-abc
```
Anika Rao: also call out proxy env vars for installs behind corporate proxies. some customers need both HTTP(S)_PROXY and NO_PROXY for internal CIDRs.
Maria Chen: added proxy section with example env.
Maria Chen: ```bash
export HTTP_PROXY="http://proxy.corp.local:3128"
export HTTPS_PROXY="http://proxy.corp.local:3128"
export NO_PROXY="127.0.0.1,localhost,10.0.0.0/8,registry.local"
```
Kyle B: tiny nit: the original PR referenced port 443 for the private API — we should show explicit examples for non-standard ports (7443) since some infra teams map 443 -> LB and break TLS validation.
Maria Chen: adjusted wording and added an ops troubleshooting bullet (TLS SNI + LB rewrite issues).
ops-bot: deploy-check: docs/pull/1234 passed link-checks but failed one internal link to the KMS plugin path.
Maria Chen: thanks bot — fixed the broken link and pushed a small amend.
Jorge Patel: LGTM after Anika confirms the security callouts.
Anika Rao: LGTM, please squash and merge when ready. add a changelog entry under "Private install" docs.
Maria Chen: will merge after CI completes. thanks everyone :heart:
